info.label: Trainer Focus
items: Frame AI as a design exploration partner, not a decision maker
Gauge audience seniority and architecture experience

info.label: Talking Points
items: Trade-off analysis is the core architecture skill
AI can surface options faster but judgment stays human
Scope: system design, documentation, decision records

info.label: Chat Prompts
items: What is your primary architecture role today?

info.label: Objective
items: Use AI to explore service boundary options quickly

info.label: Talking Points
items: Domain-driven boundary identification
Coupling and cohesion trade-offs
Communication patterns between services

info.label: Reaction Prompts
items: Monolith, microservices, or somewhere in between?

info.label: Demos
items: Generate an ADR from a verbal design discussion summary
Produce a trade-off matrix for two competing approaches
Draft a system context diagram description from requirements

info.label: Rules
items: ADRs must reflect team consensus, not raw AI output
Always list rejected alternatives and rationale

info.label: Trainer Focus
items: Reconfirm return time and restart promptly

info.label: Objective
items: Evaluate scalability patterns using AI-assisted analysis

info.label: Talking Points
items: Caching strategies and invalidation trade-offs
Circuit breaker and retry pattern selection
Load distribution and partitioning approaches

info.label: Chat Prompts
items: What scaling challenge keeps your team up at night?

info.label: Objective
items: Use AI to prioritize and document technical debt

info.label: Demos
items: Generate a technical debt inventory from codebase patterns
Produce effort-impact rankings for remediation
Draft refactoring proposals with risk assessments

info.label: Next Steps
items: Write one ADR for your next design decision using AI assistance
Catalogue top three technical debt items with AI-generated summaries
